items.glossEn: enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, [idiom] utterly.
items.defEn: to hate (personally)

items.glossEn: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.
items.defEn: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney

items.glossEn: Joab.
items.defEn: Joab, the name of three Israelites

items.glossEn: act, bondage, [phrase] bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, [idiom] wrought.
items.defEn: work of any kind

items.glossEn: bodily, body, slave
items.defEn: the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively

items.glossEn: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.
items.defEn: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve

items.glossEn: people
items.defEn: a people (in general; thus differing from G1218 (δῆμος), which denotes one's own populace)

items.glossEn: awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up
items.defEn: to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, n

items.glossEn: life(-time), (a-)live(-ly), quick
items.defEn: to live (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: (be-)love(-ed)
items.defEn: to love (in a social or moral sense)

items.glossEn: begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.
items.defEn: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge');

items.glossEn: Aram, Mesopotamia, Syria, Syrians.
items.defEn: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite

items.glossEn: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.
items.defEn: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)

items.glossEn: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).
items.defEn: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)

items.glossEn: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).
items.defEn: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, with

items.glossEn: Beth-el.
items.defEn: Beth-El, a place in Palestine

items.glossEn: noise, sound, voice
items.defEn: a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language

items.glossEn: Samuel, Shemuel.
items.defEn: Shemuel, the name of three Israelites

items.glossEn: brook, flood, river, stream, valley.
items.defEn: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)

items.glossEn: banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).
items.defEn: wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication

items.glossEn: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.
items.defEn: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)

items.glossEn: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.
items.defEn: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)

items.glossEn: [phrase] left-handed, right (hand, side), south.
items.defEn: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south

items.glossEn: crane, horse (-back, -hoof). Compare H6571 (פָּרָשׁ).
items.defEn: a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight)

items.glossEn: dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.
items.defEn: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)

items.glossEn: befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet.
items.defEn: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner

items.glossEn: cunning (man), subtil, (un-), wise((hearted), man).
items.defEn: wise, (i.e. intelligent, skilful or artful)

items.glossEn: behold, beware, lie, look (on, to), perceive, regard, see, sight, take heed
items.defEn: to look at (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: life(-time)
items.defEn: life (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: John
items.defEn: Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites

items.glossEn: -forty.
items.defEn: forty

items.glossEn: appear, at (even-) tide, behold, cast out, come on, [idiom] corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), [idiom] right (early).
items.defEn: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.

items.glossEn: put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty)
items.defEn: set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively

items.glossEn: Gilead, Gileadite.
items.defEn: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites

items.glossEn: [phrase] abundance, account, [idiom] all, [idiom] few, (in-) finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, [phrase] time.
items.defEn: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration

items.glossEn: kill, offer, (do) sacrifice, slay.
items.defEn: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)

items.glossEn: captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.
items.defEn: properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist

items.glossEn: [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ).
items.defEn: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement

items.glossEn: [idiom] in any wise, bury(-ier).
items.defEn: to inter

items.glossEn: leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.
items.defEn: properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant

items.glossEn: ([phrase] young) bull(-ock), calf, ox.
items.defEn: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof)

items.glossEn: wall, walled.
items.defEn: a wall of protection

items.glossEn: bond(-man), servant
items.defEn: a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency)

items.glossEn: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
items.defEn: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end)
items.defEn: properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future)

items.glossEn: am, was
items.defEn: to exist

items.glossEn: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, [idiom] surely, take up.
items.defEn: to grasp, i.e. collect

items.glossEn: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.
items.defEn: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)

items.glossEn: Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169 (יְחִזְקִיָּה).
items.defEn: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites

items.glossEn: assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.
items.defEn: stability; (figuratively) certainty, truth, trustworthiness

items.glossEn: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.
items.defEn: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed

items.glossEn: body, bone, [idiom] life, (self-) same, strength, [idiom] very.
items.defEn: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame

items.glossEn: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
items.defEn: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard

items.glossEn: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.
items.defEn: the half or middle

items.glossEn: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.
items.defEn: to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively

items.glossEn: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.
items.defEn: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See H2529 (חֶמְאָה).
items.defEn: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)

items.glossEn: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.
items.defEn: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the menta

items.glossEn: arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust
items.defEn: to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense)

items.glossEn: chief (high) priest, chief of the priests
items.defEn: the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest

items.glossEn: assembly, company, congregation, multitude.
items.defEn: assemblage (usually concretely)

items.glossEn: betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend
items.defEn: to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit

items.glossEn: [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.
items.defEn: to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere

items.glossEn: ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work
items.defEn: force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself)

items.glossEn: X deadly, (be…) death
items.defEn: (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.
items.defEn: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure

items.glossEn: be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means)
items.defEn: to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life)

items.glossEn: abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own
items.defEn: to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy)

items.glossEn: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past
items.defEn: to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively

items.glossEn: cast out, suburb.
items.defEn: a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around abuilding, or the margin of the sea

items.glossEn: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.
items.defEn: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone

items.glossEn: bough, (first-)fruit(-ful), reward.
items.defEn: fruit (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: [idiom] even, ([idiom] that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).
items.defEn: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity

items.glossEn: anvil, corner, foot(-step), going, (hundred-) fold, [idiom] now, (this) [phrase] once, order, rank, step, [phrase] thrice, (often-), second, this, two) time(-s), twice, wheel.
items.defEn: a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow)

items.glossEn: advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate, [phrase] things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower.
items.defEn: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)

items.glossEn: (cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, [idiom] utterly.
items.defEn: to be (causatively, set) on fire

items.glossEn: kingdom, king's, reign, royal.
items.defEn: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)

items.glossEn: be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, [phrase] be content, diligent(-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good(-ness), be (make) merry, please ([phrase] well), shew more (kindness), skilfully, [idiom] very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well (said, seen).
items.defEn: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)

items.glossEn: abominable (custom, thing), abomination.
items.defEn: properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol

items.glossEn: [phrase] babbler, bay, [phrase] evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.
items.defEn: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)

items.glossEn: assembly, church
items.defEn: a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both)

items.glossEn: make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, [idiom] surely.
items.defEn: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)

items.glossEn: burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
items.defEn: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship)

items.glossEn: holy (One), saint.
items.defEn: sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary

items.glossEn: avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think
items.defEn: by implication, to try, condemn, punish

items.glossEn: king
items.defEn: a sovereign (abstractly, relatively, or figuratively)

items.glossEn: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.
items.defEn: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out

items.glossEn: prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.
items.defEn: to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)

items.glossEn: (feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love
items.defEn: love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast

items.glossEn: (an-) other, sister, together.
items.defEn: a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively)

items.glossEn: cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).
items.defEn: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)

items.glossEn: [idiom] at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, [idiom] more, mourn, [idiom] sore, [idiom] with tears, weep.
items.defEn: to weep; generally to bemoan

items.glossEn: home, house(-hold), temple
items.defEn: a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.
items.defEn: to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)

items.glossEn: without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, [phrase] lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.
items.defEn: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)

items.glossEn: south (country, side, -ward).
items.defEn: the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine)

items.glossEn: because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.
items.defEn: properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.

items.glossEn: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with)
items.defEn: to die off (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet
items.defEn: to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation)

items.glossEn: [idiom] apiece, pillar.
items.defEn: a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform
